description: Defines the CodecAllocator class responsible for managing MediaCodec instances on Android, including creation, release, and fallback mechanisms for hardware hangs.

classes.name: CodecAllocator
classes.description: Manages allocation and release of MediaCodec instances, handles hangs, and provides fallback to software codecs.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CodecAllocator.

methods.name: CreateMediaCodecAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and configures a MediaCodec.

methods.name: IsPrimaryTaskRunnerLikelyHung
methods.description: Checks if the primary task runner is likely hung.

methods.name: SelectCodecTaskRunner
methods.description: Selects the appropriate task runner based on hang detection.

methods.name: CompletePendingOperation
methods.description: Removes completed operation from pending queue.
